title: Data science trainer
description:
TECHWINGSYS is looking for a Data Science Trainer with strong knowledge of Python and Data Science to join our training team.

The trainer will be responsible for delivering engaging training sessions, assisting students with practical exercises and projects, and supporting their overall learning journey in Data Science, Python, and Machine Learning.

Key Responsibilities

* Deliver structured and engaging training sessions on 
  **Python and Data Science**
  .
* Explain Data Science concepts clearly through practical, real-world examples.
* Assist students with 
  **practical exercises, assignments, and projects**
  .
* Provide individual guidance and support to help students understand core concepts.
* Help students build 
  **real-time projects and professional portfolios**
  .
* Conduct assessments, evaluations, and practical reviews to track student performance.
* Identify learning gaps and provide appropriate support to students.
* Guide students in applying Python and Data Science concepts to real-world problems.
* Stay updated with the latest trends, tools, technologies, and developments in 
  **Data Science and Machine Learning**
  .
* Support students in developing problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Maintain a positive, professional, and engaging learning environment.

Required Skills & Knowledge

* Strong knowledge of 
  **Python programming**
  .
* Good understanding of 
  **Data Science concepts and fundamentals**
  .
* Familiarity with Data Science libraries such as:
* **NumPy**
* **Pandas**
* **Matplotlib**
* Basic understanding of 
  **Data Analysis, Data Visualization, and Machine Learning concepts**
  .
* Ability to explain technical concepts in a simple and understandable manner.
* Good communication and presentation skills.
* Passion for teaching, mentoring, and helping students grow.

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in 
  **Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science**
  , or a related field.
* **Certification in Data Science or Python**
   will be an added advantage.

Experience

* **0–2 years of relevant experience**
   in Data Science, Python development, training, or a related field.
* Freshers with strong practical knowledge and good communication skills may also be considered.

What We Look For

* Strong technical fundamentals
* Practical, project-oriented approach
* Good communication and mentoring ability
* Willingness to continuously learn and upgrade technical skills
* Ability to work with students from different learning levels

How to Apply

title: Senior FinOps Analys
description:
**Job Description**
: Looking for a highly organized, detailed and result oriented Specialist FinOps Analyst for Federal Bank multi-cloud real-estate
  
  
Federal bank uses various cloud services that run primarily on AWS, GC and Azure for IAAS PAAS and include other SAAS solutions.
  
  
The Senior FinOps Analyst would be responsible for planning and designing a highly optimized FinOps framework to run our workloads ensuring maximumutilization of resources with an effective cost management process. The role will take a strategic and forward-looking view of the Cloud FinOps function, ensuring the Bank remains prepared for evolving cloud pricing models, regulatory expectations, technology innovations, market best practices, and changing business demand.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage monthly cloud budget and forecast process in managing consumption and savings in collaboration with accounting, finance, and technical owners.
* Support stakeholders in understanding their cloud spend based on their business roadmap and budgeted forecast
* Monitor cloud consumption at the account level to detect, investigate, and escalate anomalies and unplanned spikes.
* Take a strategic and forward-looking view of the Cloud FinOps function to ensure the Bank remains prepared for evolving cloud pricing, regulatory expectations, technology shifts, market benchmarks, and changing business demand patterns
* Design, develop, and maintain reports and KPIs that provide detailed usage statistics of resources across the multi cloud landscape.
* Evaluate and investigate data patterns to derive insightful knowledge that can inform strategic and operational decisions.
* Participate in automating, integrating, and maturing the Cloud FinOps processes and data.
* Ability to understand problems, identify opportunities for improvement and provide solutions and innovative cost-cutting initiatives
* IT MIS preparation for IT department including Financial and Internal
* Assisting in preparing Cloud Budgets and tracking expenses against them
* Monthly Provisioning of cloud expenses, co-ordination with internal Finance team for timely PO, Invoicing and Payments.
* Coordinate with different business functions including IT department, Business verticals, PMO, Application build teams and to ensure corrective measures on financial MIS
* Structuring of Processes and automation of manual activities
* Create a Cloud FinOps Governance framework
* Assist in developing and maintaining unit economics and cost-to-serve reporting
* Partner with Finance to improve cloud cost transparency and reporting accuracy
* Partner with engineering teams to execute rightsizing, storage optimization, commitment utilization, and waste reduction initiatives.
* Track optimization recommendations through implementation and realization
* Monitor savings performance and report identified versus realized savings
* Support anomaly management and investigation of unexpected spend patterns
* Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and KPIs that provide visibility into cloud spending and optimization opportunities.
* Optimize Cloud costs by tracking cost plans, Commitment discounts, and enterprise savings plans e.g., Cloud Rate Optimization
* Develop and maintain cloud infrastructure capacity and demand forecasts monitoring and tracking of cloud capacity resource mgmt. for all services
* Define cloud cost performance KPIs, benchmarking, and tracking them
* Design and create demand for building dashboards for real-time digital tracking of FinOps by departments, attributed cost and programs to the management
* Contribute to escalation of cost and risk and issues beyond certain budget thresholds

**Budget Management Work Experience Skills**

* Overall work experience of 8+ years
* 5+ years experience working as Cloud FinOps Analyst
* 2+ years experience leading FinOps and Cloud engineering teams
* Proven track record of setting up FinOps capabilities, tooling, governance frameworks, and operating processes from scratch in complex cloud environments.
* Experience with cloud billing and cost management modules
* Good knowledge of forecasting, and predicting cost of organizations / organizational units
* Reporting and cost financial data maintenance and availability management.
* Stakeholder management and liaising with multiple verticals.
* Automation and tooling for FinOps analytics
* Good knowledge of public cloud players (AWS, GCP, Azure, Oracle), their product portfolio and commercial models
* Knowledge of the core Finance principles and basic understanding of the corporate accounting process (forecast, invoicing, show back, accruals, procurement, etc.)

**FinOps Educational Qualification**

* Bachelors or Masters degree in computer science or equivalent experience/certification or knowledge in cloud platforms with a leading CSP, or MBA with background in commercial management of cloud providers and services

This job is provided by Shine.com

title: FinOps Analyst
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented FinOps Analyst to join our team. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in managing financial operations and ensuring the alignment of financial processes with business objectives. As a FinOps Analyst, you will be responsible for analyzing financial data, optimizing cloud spending, and providing insights to improve financial performance. Key Responsibilities: - Analyze and report on cloud financial metrics to drive cost optimization. - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure financial accountability and transparency. - Develop and maintain financial models to forecast cloud spending and usage. - Identify opportunities for cost savings and efficiency improvements in cloud operations. - Assist in the development of financial policies and procedures related to cloud services. - Provide training and support to teams on financial best practices in cloud usage. Required Skills: - Strong analytical skills with a focus on financial data analysis. - Proficiency in financial modeling and forecasting. - Excellent communication skills to convey complex financial information clearly. - Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment. - Familiarity with cloud financial management tools and practices is a plus. This role offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to the financial success of our organization while working in a dynamic and innovative environment. If you are passionate about financial operations and have a keen interest in cloud technologies, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
This job is provided by Shine.com

title: Cloud Cost Optimization Specialist
description:
We are seeking a Cloud Cost Optimization Specialist to join our team in Kerala. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in cloud cost management and billing processes, with a focus on optimizing cloud expenditures for our organization. This role is critical in ensuring that our cloud resources are utilized efficiently and cost-effectively, contributing to the overall financial health of our cloud operations. Key Responsibilities: - Analyze cloud usage and spending patterns to identify areas for cost reduction and optimization. - Develop and implement strategies for cloud cost management, including budgeting, forecasting, and reporting. - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment on cloud resource usage and cost management initiatives. - Monitor cloud billing processes and ensure accuracy in billing statements and invoices. - Provide insights and recommendations to stakeholders on best practices for cloud cost optimization. - Stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies related to cloud cost management. Required Skills: - Proven experience in cloud cost optimization and management. - Strong understanding of cloud billing processes and tools. - Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. - Ability to communicate complex financial concepts to non-financial stakeholders. - Proficiency in data analysis tools and techniques. If you are passionate about cloud technology and have a knack for optimizing costs, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.
  
  
This job is provided by Shine.com

title: Fleet Performance Superintendent
description:
As a
 **Fleet Performance Superintendent** 
 at
 **BSM,** 
 you will be responsible to monitor and provide timely advice for improving the Operational Performance of the fully managed fleet using all available resources for optimising efficiency, reliability and competitiveness.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Monitors and supports the Company’s drive towards its goals in technical reliability and energy efficient operation, thereby assisting its Clients achieve and maintain their competitive edge.
* Helps develop the Company’s proprietary software platform using existing methodologies as directed by supervisor.
* Monitors and refines modelling methods so as to ensure the software platform always maintains BSM’s lead among competitors.
* Explores software and hardware solutions that can improve the reporting, modelling and analysis quality.
* Ensures the implementation of the performance monitoring system across the fleet.
* Monitors adherence of the ships to predefined reporting frequency and quality standards. Provides guidance and support to the ship’s staff as required.
* Provides support and guidance to the SMC wherever retrofitting of equipment is required and follows up the installation \& implementation process.
* Provides expert advice to the responsible SMC based on the performance analysis results.
* Provides regular reports to Fleet Management.
* Provides suggestions for expanding the performance monitoring portfolio.
* Supports the SMCs with Client specific performance monitoring systems, issuing formal guidance wherever required.
* Supports the COO office team with Analysis Reports related to the fleet’s performance.
* Supports S.M.C. and Clients with the selection of Makers at the newbuilding stage by providing advice based on documented performance records.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* MSc in Marine Engineering and/or Naval Architecture or equivalent
* Preferably 1 year in the technical department of a ship management/owningcompany,shipyard,researchfacilityorClassification society
* Experience with model tests, shop tests and/or sea trials considered a big advantage
* Minimum of five years’ sailing experience


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Very strong analytical skills
* High IT proficiency, preferably with programming knowledge
* Very good project management and organisational skills
* Open to new ideas and keen to challenge convention
* High level of organisation, attention to detail, and problem\-solving ability
* Team\-oriented, proactive, and safety\-focused approach


**Why You Should Join Us!**
 We offer a supportive environment, competitive compensation, and meaningful opportunities. By joining us, you will enjoy:
   

  

* On\-the\-job training.
* First\-hand exposure to the growing maritime technological industry.
* Diverse workforce.
* Technology\-driven company.
* Be a part of the ever\-growing Schulte group family!
